summary.result: In this study, research has been conducted to improve the accuracy of oil spill detection by improving the quality of radar images, which are used as input data to detect oil spills.
summary.background: The detection of oil spills using radar image has been studied extensively.
summary.method: Thresholding algorithms were used to measure the image improvement both before and after processing.
